decisions.quote:
First, we verified that we replicated
Guo et al.’s (2017)
results by conducting a 2 (frame: gain, loss) × 2 (time constraint:
none, 1 s) repeated measures ANOVA on the proportion of choices in
which the gamble was selected.
decisions.reason: The authors explicitly verify that they replicated Guo et al.'s (2017) behavioral finding that time constraints amplify the framing effect. Adding eye tracking to argue for an attentional mechanism over a dual-system theoretical interpretation extends the original study rather than showing the original effect or method was flawed.
